role: Checkpoint roundtrip gate (K01): compares the Snapshot taken before a save op's Save and Quit with the Snapshot a --from run takes after its quiet join; blocks, tile entities, player and entity NBT must match and every other difference must fall under a named, counted reset (chunk-set, entity-unloaded, entity-spawned, join-write, light, rotation-wrap, chunk-cache).
notes: Reads Snapshot directories written by Snapshot.java; no native consumer.
